title: Medicare’s Paying Less for Cataract Surgery. Eye Doctors Are Turning to Lucrative Lasers.
summary: More cataract patients, wanting not only restored but improved vision, are paying extra for their doctors to use a laser when a scalpel would do.

title: You Want To Join a Clinical Trial. Here’s What To Know About the Hurdles.

title: Drive for Nuclear Power Boosts Uranium Industry — And Tribal Health Concerns in Southwest
summary: Federal efforts to revive uranium mining in the West and decrease reliance on Russian uranium are raising concerns about drinking water for tribal communities reckoning with the industry’s deadly legacy.

summary: These specialized units can help keep older patients out of the hospital, lower their healthcare costs, and more.

title: Newsom Promotes Affordable Insulin, but California’s Generic Label Off to a Slow Start
summary: California is the first to launch state-branded insulin as Gov. Gavin Newsom tries to disrupt the pharmaceutical industry. But the new CalRx drug label has been slow to reach pharmacies and patients.

title: Kennedy’s Quiet Hunt for Autism Culprits Stalls as Trump Orders Baseless Changes to Childhood Shots
summary: The Trump administration is working to implement the president’s new order on childhood vaccines, which he publicly faulted for a rise in autism — even as health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s closed-door research has yet to produce evidence linking them.
